limitations: Bundle counts and shapes were explored before this development manifest was frozen; no statistic is confirmatory or blind.
Only CollateralConfigurationChanged is semantically decoded; other Configurator topics remain opaque identities.
Previous emitted configuration is not authoritative historical reserve state.
Transaction grouping does not expose receipts, payloads, call paths or state changes in other contracts.
A structural bundle is not an exogenous intervention and does not identify any component-level causal effect.
The parent contains no accounts, participant actions, prices or realized responses; this audit cannot admit G1.
